name: Impostor Professor Oak
ability: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

name: Item Finder
ability: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Lass
ability: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

name: Pokemon Breeder
ability: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

name: Pokemon Trader
ability: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Scoop Up
ability: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

name: Super Energy Removal
ability: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

name: Defender
ability: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Energy Retrieval
ability: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

name: Full Heal
ability: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Maintenance
ability: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

name: PlusPower
